cases.scenario: final fiscal device unavailable
cases.invariant: BLOCKED before journal or sequence allocation

cases.scenario: timeout after device accept
cases.invariant: UNKNOWN is durable and never blindly re-executed

cases.scenario: known paper/device failure
cases.invariant: known failure is stable and idempotent

cases.scenario: corrupted encrypted frame and replay
cases.invariant: bad tag and replay are rejected

cases.scenario: chunk reorder, duplicate, resume and busy
cases.invariant: one canonical payload is assembled exactly once

cases.scenario: revoked or expired ticket
cases.invariant: execution is rejected before session readiness

cases.scenario: expired, exhausted or stale fencing lease
cases.invariant: no allocation outside lease

cases.scenario: authority handback
cases.invariant: new fence and ranges are monotonic; old owner is rejected

cases.scenario: restart between durable command and result
cases.invariant: sequence allocation never moves backwards

cases.scenario: journal sequence gap
cases.invariant: gapped batch is not uploaded

cases.scenario: partial ACK, backend rollback, malformed ACK, transport loss
cases.invariant: journal remains unacknowledged and identical batch recovers

cases.scenario: ACK for another batch
cases.invariant: batch/hash binding is mandatory

cases.scenario: signed contiguous ACK and verifier restart
cases.invariant: cursor/hash acknowledgement survives restart

cases.scenario: 70/85/95/100 percent thresholds
cases.invariant: WARNING/HIGH/CRITICAL/FULL boundaries are deterministic

cases.scenario: critical media pressure
cases.invariant: 95 percent blocks before any fiscal side effect

cases.scenario: warning and high media pressure
cases.invariant: 70/85 percent remain operational and observable

cases.scenario: acknowledged record before and after three months
cases.invariant: no early deletion; eligible prefix is safely removed

cases.scenario: unacknowledged gap in retained prefix
cases.invariant: GC never creates a journal gap

cases.scenario: clock rollback and early boundary
cases.invariant: rollback cannot shorten retention

cases.scenario: compliance intent replay after an ambiguous route result
cases.invariant: the selected local route is durable and replay never causes a second fiscal-device execution

cases.scenario: MiniPOS or Fiscal HTTP endpoint accepts a connection but never completes
cases.test: bounded fetch aborts a hung request
cases.invariant: all UI public-API calls leave the busy state through a deterministic four-second abort instead of waiting forever

cases.scenario: two concurrent MiniPOS shift-close requests race before the first Z result
cases.invariant: the OPEN-to-CLOSING transition is revalidated under the domain mutex and exactly one Z command is emitted

cases.scenario: two reversal requests with different idempotency keys race while the first storno is in flight
cases.invariant: a durable pre-network UNKNOWN transition freezes the original order and exactly one storno reaches Fiscal

cases.scenario: signed reversal webhook commits before the synchronous Fiscal response returns
cases.invariant: the same already-confirmed reversal operation is accepted idempotently instead of being reported as an ambiguous state change

cases.scenario: two payments race on the same OPEN Fiscal sale before the first driver result
cases.invariant: sale version and OPEN state are atomically reserved as PAYMENT_PENDING with EXECUTING operation before exactly one driver side effect

cases.scenario: device confirms the final payment but atomic sale/operation/receipt persistence fails
cases.invariant: no partial final state or orphan receipt is exposed; durable reservation survives and restart converts EXECUTING/PAYMENT_PENDING to UNKNOWN/RECONCILE without replaying the device command

cases.scenario: process restarts with reversal, report or another fiscal command durably left EXECUTING
cases.invariant: every interrupted fiscal operation becomes UNKNOWN with explicit RECONCILE authority; startup never replays its device side effect

cases.scenario: two direct Fiscal API reversal requests race on one completed sale
cases.invariant: sale CAS and EXECUTING reversal are persisted as FISCALIZATION_PENDING before exactly one driver side effect

cases.scenario: durable EXECUTING write fails before an X/Z/cash/device-management command
cases.invariant: driver is never invoked unless the command reservation is durable

cases.scenario: process restarts after reversal reservation but before its terminal result is durable
cases.invariant: both sale and reversal become UNKNOWN/RECONCILE without automatic storno replay

cases.scenario: the first durable mutation fails while the authoritative snapshot is empty
cases.invariant: all in-memory entity and audit maps return to the confirmed empty snapshot

cases.scenario: periodized compliance export persistence fails during publication
cases.invariant: manifest resource, operation, every period artifact and audit evidence publish together or none become visible

cases.scenario: report command returns an ambiguous fiscal-device result
cases.invariant: operation is UNKNOWN/RECONCILE and no COMPLETED report resource or artifact is fabricated

cases.scenario: device confirms report command but atomic operation/report/artifact publication fails
cases.invariant: durable EXECUTING reservation remains without orphan report/artifact and restart converts it to UNKNOWN/RECONCILE without device replay

cases.scenario: terminal fiscal payment state and its webhook outbox event are committed under storage failure or duplicate queue request
cases.invariant: sale, operation, receipt and exactly one version-bound outbox event become durable together; retrying queue publication is idempotent

cases.scenario: X/Z/cash/device-management command reaches a terminal state
cases.invariant: operation and its version-bound fiscal.operation.updated outbox event commit together

cases.scenario: report command succeeds or its atomic publication fails after device confirmation
cases.invariant: fiscal.operation.updated and register.report.completed publish atomically with operation, report and artifact; failed publication leaks no event

cases.scenario: UNKNOWN to RECONCILING transition cannot persist its reconciliation-required outbox event
cases.invariant: operation remains UNKNOWN with no event; successful transition atomically emits version-bound fiscal.operation.reconciliation_required marked lookup-only and never replays the device command

cases.scenario: shift closes while its own register has an unresolved operation
cases.invariant: EXECUTING, UNKNOWN and RECONCILING all move the shift to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED before close

cases.scenario: legacy sale operation lacks register_id during shift-close recovery
cases.invariant: register is derived from the durable sale and unresolved legacy work still blocks the correct shift

cases.scenario: many callers open a shift concurrently on one tenant/register
cases.invariant: the atomic uniqueness check creates exactly one OPEN shift

cases.scenario: replacement shift is requested over an unresolved predecessor or the same register identifier exists in another autonomous tenant
cases.invariant: OPEN/CLOSING/RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED block only the same tenant/register; another tenant remains autonomous

cases.scenario: many callers create a sale for one tenant/external order using independent request identities
cases.invariant: exactly one sale owns tenant/external_id regardless of request identity

cases.scenario: a recovered snapshot contains an issued UNP but its sequence counter lags behind
cases.invariant: new allocation skips every already-issued tenant UNP instead of failing or reusing the number

cases.scenario: two MiniPOS backend replicas receive the same first mutation while the claim owner is still executing
cases.invariant: a durable PENDING claim is committed before business execution; the losing replica returns retryable conflict and the completed response is replayed without a second handler call

cases.scenario: MiniPOS mutation returns an ambiguous server failure after a possible side effect
cases.invariant: the durable claim remains PENDING and retries fail closed instead of re-executing the possible side effect

cases.scenario: two Fiscal backend replicas receive the same first mutation while the claim owner is still executing
cases.invariant: a durable PENDING claim serializes execution; the loser is retryable and later replays the exact completed response

cases.scenario: Fiscal mutation returns an ambiguous server failure after a possible device or domain side effect
cases.invariant: the durable claim remains PENDING and retry never re-executes the ambiguous fiscal command

cases.scenario: Fiscal process restarts after durable idempotency claim but before any HTTP result is stored
cases.invariant: orphan claim becomes durable replayable 503 IDEMPOTENCY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is never reclaimed for blind fiscal execution

cases.scenario: MiniPOS process restarts after durable idempotency claim but before any HTTP result is stored
cases.invariant: orphan claim becomes durable replayable 503 IDEMPOTENCY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is never reclaimed for duplicate business or downstream Fiscal execution

cases.scenario: a Fiscal idempotency key is reused with the same body but different query or If-Match condition
cases.invariant: the server-observed mutation fingerprint rejects changed target parameters or concurrency preconditions instead of replaying an unrelated response

cases.scenario: a MiniPOS idempotency key is reused with changed query, If-Match or X-App-Instance-Id
cases.invariant: query, conditional version and workstation identity are bound into the durable request fingerprint

cases.scenario: a completed Fiscal mutation is replayed after its original representation headers were durably captured
cases.invariant: status, body, Content-Type, ETag and Location are replayed while Set-Cookie and arbitrary response headers are never persisted

cases.scenario: a completed MiniPOS mutation is replayed after its original representation headers were durably captured
cases.invariant: status, body, Content-Type, ETag and Location are replayed while Set-Cookie and arbitrary response headers are never persisted

cases.scenario: concurrent Fiscal admin requests create the same case-insensitive location code, device serial or organization for one tenant
cases.invariant: the repository admits exactly one tenant-owned business identity; another tenant remains independent and PostgreSQL has matching partial unique indexes

cases.scenario: two Fiscal admin updates use the same valid If-Match version concurrently
cases.invariant: resource data is detached from repository state and version is compared atomically at commit, so exactly one update reaches version 2 and no lost update occurs

cases.scenario: another authenticated Fiscal principal in the same tenant reuses a completed mutation key and identical payload
cases.invariant: issuer and subject are bound into the durable fingerprint; only the original principal can replay the response

cases.scenario: another authenticated MiniPOS principal in the same tenant and app instance reuses a completed mutation key and identical payload
cases.invariant: issuer and subject are bound into the durable fingerprint without persisting a bearer token; cross-principal replay is rejected

cases.scenario: MiniPOS creates an explicitly INACTIVE product or employee and persists it through the typed projection
cases.invariant: active is derived from canonical status at creation; inactive catalog/workforce objects cannot appear operational and PostgreSQL enforces the same equivalence

cases.scenario: Fiscal sale line uses variable canonical quantity scale, half-cent rounding, negative price or an overflowing price-times-quantity product
cases.invariant: integer fixed-point arithmetic accepts every canonical 0..3 quantity scale, rounds half-up exactly once and rejects negative or overflowing line totals before persistence/device execution

cases.scenario: MiniPOS order arithmetic reaches a half-cent boundary or int64 multiplication/addition overflow
cases.invariant: EUR cents and thousandth quantities are calculated without float, with deterministic half-up rounding and fail-closed overflow before order mutation

cases.scenario: MiniPOS sends an absolute EUR line discount through the public Fiscal API
cases.invariant: discount is included unchanged in the SaleLine command, total and payment are net of it exactly once, and replay emits no duplicate sale

cases.scenario: an offline fiscal sale contains a discounted line and later synchronizes through the Edge journal
cases.invariant: the signed offline payload preserves discount evidence, validates the net payment total and materializes the same immutable line snapshot after sync

cases.scenario: a cashier bypasses the hidden MiniPOS controls and submits a discounted line directly to the public API
cases.invariant: the backend requires SUPERVISOR or ADMIN authority for every non-zero line discount; client-side visibility is never the authorization boundary

cases.scenario: SUPTO compliance artifacts are requested as JSON, CSV and XLSX for a completed discounted sale
cases.invariant: every format contains immutable line, discount, tax group, exact net total, tender and fiscal receipt linkage instead of an identifier-only placeholder

cases.scenario: a historical sale contains EUR monetary evidence inside the legally BGN export period
cases.invariant: period generation fails closed instead of relabeling line, discount or payment amounts into another official currency

cases.scenario: the register is rebound to another fiscal device after a completed sale
cases.invariant: payment reservation atomically freezes the original device ID, serial, FMIN/FM and vendor/model/firmware; receipt and artifact never follow the mutable current binding

cases.scenario: a typed-only PostgreSQL sale is saved and reconstructed with fiscal-device identity evidence
cases.invariant: normalized indexed device/FMIN/FM columns and exact payload agree and survive tenant-scoped typed reconstruction

cases.scenario: a compliance export is filtered by point of sale and fiscal device after sale completion
cases.invariant: location and end-device filters match immutable sale-time snapshots; unknown identities return no historical rows and current register bindings are never consulted

cases.scenario: cloud routing is lost after a BLE authority session was issued
cases.invariant: the encrypted POS intent is processed under the signed Edge/final-device binding and regulatory identity is generated only inside the compliance gateway
